components.name: Gilded Lance
components.blurb: A laser in a gold-leaf housing, because a Baron's guns are looked at before they are fired. The leaf is real. So is the beam.
components.quirk: Hits a tier above a Laser Mk2 (5 damage, and it punches through one more plate), but the gilt runs hot: every shot adds 9 heat, so it wants a radiator.

components.name: Tithe Gun
components.blurb: A deck gun with a chandelier mount. The Barons call what it fires a tithe, and the people it is fired at call it other things.
components.quirk: A heavy gilt slug (6 damage, and it breaches the wall it hits 15% of the time) that jams on 10% of volleys: the tithe is not always paid on time.

components.name: Sovereign Turret
components.blurb: Twin gilded barrels on a swivel, polished daily by someone who is not allowed to touch anything else.
components.quirk: Two shots a volley from a turret that misses little (85% accurate), but the gilt is vain: with nobody in its room it fires at 60% of its rate.

components.name: Sovereign Aegis
components.blurb: A Baron's personal shield: three layers, a gold rim, and a power bill that has ended more than one barony.
components.quirk: Relic. Three layers that come back in 1.6 s instead of 2 (a Shield Mk2 has two), but it draws 7 power (a Mk2 draws 4) and runs warm: it wants a radiator.
